info.description: Use the IBM Hybrid Cloud Mesh (Mesh) APIs described in this specification to manage network and application resources, including Red Hat Service Interconnect gateways. You can also see details of a topology that provides the relationships between the resources. APIs are also available for authorization tasks, for managing your tenant, and for managing events and subscription usage.

post.description:
Onboard the first administrator of a new tenant or a user within an existing tenant. The `user_name` attribute is always required.
To onboard the first administrator of a new tenant, the `tenant_id` and `user_id` attributes are required. The `tenant_id` must be a fully qualified identifier in the following format: `<provider-name>/<tenant-id>`. The API must be called by an authenticated user with the `Hubadmin` role, as defined in the microservice configuration file.
To onboard a new user of an existing tenant, the `tenant_id` and `user_id` attributes are ignored. The API must be called by an authenticated admin in the same tenant.
